neutral.anchor_measurement: manually observed anatomical support/centre in the native full-body image; not alpha-canvas centering
neutral.anchor_basis: Simplified side-view shark trunk, snout to tail peduncle; paired fins and tail excluded from anatomical body reference. Floating prop uses body-center support rather than fictitious feet.
neutral.vertical_motion_policy: neutral still; scene placement and any trajectory are designed by consumer, no motion acceptance claimed

geometry_policy: Native pixels and adopted per-frame references retained. Atlas neutral coordinates are shifted only by the adopted crop origin.
